integrity: All reported rational coordinates, best-response decisions, and return multipliers reproduced from standalone exact-arithmetic code. Finite checks corroborate the constructive proof, not a complete census or general independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Counterexample concerns admitted simultaneous revision and the arXiv preprint version; no assertion for strictly singleton asynchronous updates, noisy populations, or the special sufficient global-defection regime. Earlier work already exhibits synchrony-induced cycles in other models. No independent audit.
scientific_scope: Four-player noncooperative public-goods and Friedkin–Johnsen opinion game; synchronous myopic best response allowed under the source revision assumption; homogeneous positive payoff weights and complete positive-off-diagonal social influence.
title: Stable period-two switching on a complete network in an opinion–action public-goods game
